* Improved Conductive Runes' description to explicitly state that its damage is not based on your weapon's damage. * Fixed a bug where Conductive Runes would deal no damage if you had certain two handed weapon types equipped. * Fixed a bug where Conductive Runes' damage did not scale with modifiers to hazard damage.
* Conductive Runes now has a base Critical Strike Chance of 7%.
